title: fix(spec)!: HttpFindQueryParamsSchema declares the count and select values the list door accepts
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB4PUNmhZj9zTbsZNNYma5Qa)_

Fixes #26817

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` teaches only the boolean count (`skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md:90`, `$count: true`) and never a blank `select`; the generated reference page `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` is regenerated in this diff.

**BREAKING** (accept-set narrowing of a published declaration, `patch`): `HttpFindQueryParamsSchema` refuses a `count` other than true/false and a `select` naming no field, which it admitted. The list door already refused both with a 400 (since #26811). ADR-0087 disposition in the changeset: `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`GET /data/:object` 查询参数的公开声明 `HttpFindQueryParamsSchema` 收窄：`count` 只收 `true`/`false`（字符串 `'false'` 读作 false），`select` 必须至少点名一个字段，空串、纯空格、只有逗号的值都被拒。
- **为什么改**：服务端列表接口早已对这些值回 400，但声明还写着「什么都收」，`'false'` 甚至被读成 true；按声明生成的客户端或 AI 作者会写出运行时被拒的请求。
- **风险与回滚**：只影响用这个 schema 解析查询串的代码；接口运行时行为不变（声明没有运行时读者）。回滚只需还原 `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` 里该块的两行声明。
- **先看**：`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`（`HttpFindQueryParamsSchema` 的 `select`、`count` 两行）、`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.test.ts`（新增用例）、`.changeset/26817-http-find-query-params-count-select.md`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/api/protocol.test.ts`，预期 215 个用例全绿，其中 `reads count="false" as false`、`refuses count="maybe"`、`refuses select=","` 都在。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`count`** reads the door's accept set from the one declaration the door parses, `QueryTransportParamsSchema.shape.count` (which `findData`'s `countFlagValue` checks): the boolean, or the strings `'true'` / `'false'`. The nullable arm is unwrapped (a querystring carries no `null`), and the value is lowered to the boolean it means, so `'false'` parses as `false`. It replaces `z.coerce.boolean()`, which read `'false'` as `true` and admitted `'maybe'`, `'1'` and a blank value.
- **`select`** must name at least one field: `z.string().regex(/[^\s,]/)`. This is the door's own rule measured in `projectionFieldsValue`: it splits on commas, trims each member, drops empty members and refuses only when nothing is left. So a blank, whitespace-only or comma-only value is refused, and `name,,email` or ` name , email ` stay accepted, as at the door. `\s` is the set `trim()` strips. A regex is a string format check, not a `.refine()`, so it is published as a JSON Schema `pattern` and adds no `dropped-refinements` row.
- **`.describe()` texts** state the new accept sets; the reference page regenerates from them.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.test.ts`: `count` `'true'`/`'false'`/`true`/`false` parse to `true`/`false`; `'maybe'`, `'1'`, `'0'`, `''`, `'TRUE'`, `1`, `null` refused; `select` `''`, `'   '`, `','`, `' , ,'`, tab refused; `name`, `name,email`, ` name , email `, `name,,email` accepted unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- **Readers of `HttpFindQueryParamsSchema`.** Regenerated: `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` (`gen:docs`, in this diff). Unchanged by construction (key-level, keys unchanged): `authorable-surface`, `api-surface`, `declaration-map`, `export-origins`, `json-schema.manifest`, `dropped-refinements.baseline.json`; `check:generated` and the build are green. Prose only: `packages/client/src/index.ts:371`, `packages/client/src/client.test.ts:1969`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/data.ts:410`, `packages/spec/src/data/query.zod.ts:215`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/manage/orgEnvironments.ts:64`, CHANGELOG entries. Test reader: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.page-window-declared.test.ts` (top/skip only), green.
- **Clients in this repo.** No client sends `count` at all, and none sends a non-boolean count string (`git grep` over `packages`, `examples`, `apps`). `ObjectStackClient.data.find` and `ScopedEnvironmentClient.data.find` (`packages/client/src/index.ts:7060`, `:7946`) send `select` as `select.join(',')` whenever `select` is truthy, so `select: []` sends `?select=`. Not changed here: the door answers it with a 400 naming `select`, and dropping it client-side would turn an empty projection into "every column", the widening #26811 closed. Reported to the seat for a ruling.
- **Siblings, out of scope.** `GetDataRequestSchema.select` (`z.array(z.string())`) is on the by-id door (`getData`), not `findData`, and admits `[]` that `getData` refuses. `QueryTransportParamsSchema.select` / `$select` (and the canonical `fields`) sit on the same `findData` door and admit a blank string or `[]`, but they also feed `QueryWithTransportSchema` and the `POST /data/:object/query` body declaration, outside this card's file surface. Both are reported to the seat, not folded.
- **Clause-② and Metadata-protocol.** `no (narrowing)`: only a published accept set shrinks, nothing is widened, no key moves. `Metadata-protocol: none`: this is a querystring transport declaration, not metadata an author stores; no metadata type, key or stored shape changes.
